messages:
maria_support: FYI customer org_67542 says they applied a promo in the customer portal, then our support team applied a second promo via the admin API. The net effect was the trial credit got replaced instead of both credits showing. They expect stacking. Ticket #8421 contains screenshots. Anyone seen replacement behavior like this?
sam_billing: Can you paste the account id, the two promo codes, and the exact timestamps? Also: were either promos marked as 'non-stackable' when created? :thinking:
maria_support: account: org_67542, promo codes: WELCOME2024 and SUPPORT50, portal apply at 2002002410, admin apply at 2002002902. Both promos looked to be created as 'percent' bonuses in the UI; I didn't see a stack flag in the portal. customer says portal showed +$50 then after our manual apply the balance dropped to just $50 (the second promo), effectively overwrote the trial.
alyssa_prod: heads-up: we have two different code paths. Portal redemption goes through promo-service.v1.redeem (which checks promo.stackable flag) and admin apply uses /admin/v1/promos/assign which historically did "replace" semantics for legacy trial grants. If the original trial was a legacy trial-type (grant.type == "trial") admin path may have used replace logic. That mismatch could cause the overwrite.
paul_engineer: @maria_support thanks for the repro data. I can try to reproduce locally. Quick Q: do we have the exact promo metadata (json) for WELCOME2024 and SUPPORT50? need to know if stackable:true/false and source fields.
maria_support: sending relevant log snippets from the org audit (redacted):
```
2024-11-02T14:20:10Z INFO promo-redeem user=customer portal redeem code=WELCOME2024 result=ok grant_id=g-9832 amount=50 source=portal grant_type=trial
2024-11-02T14:28:22Z INFO admin-apply user=support agent=ui-admin-api apply code=SUPPORT50 result=ok grant_id=g-9981 amount=50 source=manual_apply
2024-11-02T14:28:23Z INFO balance-update org=org_67542 previous_balance=50 new_balance=50 delta=0 note=replace_existing_grant grant_removed=g-9832
```
paul_engineer: that "replace_existing_grant" line is the smoking gun. Looks like the admin apply flow triggered replace semantics. I suspect a conditional check: if incoming_grant.source == "manual_apply" then replace legacy trials. I'll open a repro ticket and assign to eng-runtime.
sam_billing: Is there any 4xx/5xx returned to the caller? The portal call succeeded and admin apply returned 200?
maria_support: both returned 200 to the caller. No errors surfaced in the UI. The customer saw the UI momentarily show both credits, then final balance reflected only the second.
paul_engineer: repro plan I'm going to run: 1) create a new org via admin test harness 2) create a legacy-style trial promo and apply via portal redeem 3) apply second promo via /admin/v1/promos/assign (curl below) 4) inspect grants table and balance. Curl I plan to use:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/admin/v1/promos/assign \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"org_id":"org_test_123","code":"SUPPORT50","actor":"support-agent"}'
```
paul_engineer: I'll paste results in this thread. If I can reproduce, we should either: (a) change admin assign to preserve stacking when target grant is trial and new promo.stackable==true, or (b) make admin UI warn that it will replace trials.
maria_support: customer-facing note request: can we get a short explanation to tell the customer why their earlier trial grant disappeared and what we're doing? They are on a tight rollout and worried credits were lost.
alyssa_prod: for customer note: apologize + explain mismatch between portal and admin paths; temporary mitigation: we can re-apply the removed grant if they still meet trial criteria (manual restore). long-term: engineer fix to admin assign semantics + add a log-level dashboard alert when replace occurs.
deploy-bot: schedule:parity-fix promoted to staging by paul_engineer at 2002003500
paul_engineer: reproduced locally, confirmed admin path uses replace logic on any grant where existing_grant.type == "trial". Filing ENG-5634 with details and patch. Will request prioritization.
maria_support: thanks — I'll update ticket #8421 and let the customer know we can restore the trial grant while we push the fix. :pray:
